key_concepts: Matter is anything that occupies space and has mass and volume.
A chemical substance has a definite composition throughout.
Substances can be classified as elements or compounds.
Elements are made of only one kind of atom.
Elements are the simplest form of matter and cannot be broken down into simpler substances
Each element has a unique set of properties.
Elements may be metals, nonmetals, or metalloids.
Compounds are combinations of two or more elements.
Compounds can be broken down into their component elements by chemical processes.
Compounds have properties different from the elements that form them.
Water is a compound made of hydrogen and oxygen, while salt is made of sodium and chlorine
Food labels contain substances that can be classified as elements or compounds.
